name: ai-customer-support
description: AI Customer Support Platform — modular monolith with hexagonal architecture.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,widget -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:widget"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @ai-customer-support/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ai-customer-support/shared && npm run build -w @ai-customer-support/config && npm run build -w @ai-customer-support/contracts
scripts.build: prisma generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ai-customer-support/api && npm run build -w @ai-customer-support/web && npm run build -w @ai-customer-support/widget
scripts.typecheck: prisma generate && tsc -b --pretty && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/widget/tsconfig.json --noEmit
